note: Known-answer vectors for message replies (WIRE_SPEC section 13). Generated by tools/katgen/reply with the Go standard library only. Message ids are test UUIDs derived from public labels. Clients pin the SHA-256 of this file.

recognition.why: an ordinary text

recognition.why: the canonical form of a reply

recognition.name: space_inside_name

recognition.name: uppercase_name
recognition.why: names are compared as bytes, no case folding

recognition.name: version_0

recognition.name: version_minus_1

recognition.name: version_2_invalid_utf8

recognition.name: version_1_0

recognition.name: version_string
recognition.why: not a plain integer

recognition.name: version_leading_zero

recognition.name: version_exponent
recognition.why: not a plain integer

recognition.name: version_plus
recognition.why: not a plain integer

recognition.name: version_fullwidth_digit
recognition.why: only ASCII digits: the fullwidth digit one is not 1

recognition.name: version_too_large
recognition.why: a magnitude above 2^53 - 1 is not an integer of the format
